title: Slovakian Wonton Dumplings Recipe
description: A traditional Slovakian dish with a twist, using wonton wrappers instead of traditional dumpling dough.
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook the chopped onion and garlic until softened.
In a large bowl, combine the ground pork, flour, egg, and cooked onion mixture. Mix well to combine.
Lay a wonton wrapper on a clean surface. Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with a little water, then fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
In a large skillet or wok, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat. When the oil is hot, add a few of the wonton dumplings to the pan.
Cook the dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the dumplings from the pan and repeat with the remaining dumplings.
Serve the wonton dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
